name: Dwarf in the Flask
description: (Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)(Character)The Dwarf in the Flask is Hohenheim's first homunculus made from an eye shard with tank-shredding amorphous darkness and great might. Its true power is vast alchemy knowledge for circles, soul-derived philosopher stones, homunculi, chimeras, and teaching Alchemy (Note: Does not possess the power of Truth nor can it reach it due to it not existing in other worlds).
